lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(home): a prompt per role that lets an AI assistant explain lernapps.net

## Intent

People who land on the home page should be able to ask their own AI assistant what lernapps.net offers someone in their role. A ready prompt per role lets them do that in one copy. The answers must convey safety: listed apps meet the same requirements even when they are hosted by their makers, not on lernapps.net.

## Key changes

- Each role in the solution section (teacher, parent, maker, learner) has an open box "Frag deinen KI-Assistenten" with a prompt to copy, in German and English.
- Each prompt points the assistant to llms.txt and the catalogue at /apps/, and asks how apps are checked and whether the same requirements apply to apps that are not on lernapps.net itself but with their makers.
- The maker's prompt asks what they get back when someone uses their app; the learner's prompt offers to build a small app together when the catalogue has nothing on the topic.
- A copy button is added by JavaScript; without it the prompt stays readable.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The prompts were tried with fresh assistants per role; the last wording change was not retested.
